title: Certified Verification of Asymptotic (1-epsilon)-MMS Allocations
abstract: We construct a standalone zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 formalization of 18 core Abel-summation, prefix-LP duality, checkpoint-rounding, deadline-assignment, small-slack dual-price, M2''-sharing, cyclic-compression, and eta-faithfulness theorems (zero sorry, zero warnings, zero Classical.choice) for Zehan Lin, Shengxin Liu, Biaoshuai Tao, Xiaowei Wu, and Yuhao Zhang (arXiv:2611.33052, Nov 2026), paired with a zero-floating-point exact rational/integer four-mode certificate verifier (MMS-ASYMP-CERT-1.0). Across 16 canonical certificates (0.671-25.122 ms, total 64.84 ms), all exact primal-dual witnesses, Algorithm 3.1 deadline allocations, Lemma A.1 cyclic compressions, Lemma 3.11 fractional sharings, and Appendix B comparison groupings and eta-faithful auxiliary valuations replay deterministically while rejecting 60/60 live adversarial forgery attacks.

editorial.statement: Accepted under AIRR-FOUNDER-1.0 author-editor governance following two distinct frontier-model assessments (Google/hydrogen and Google/carbon) with zero unresolved material objections and verified Lean 4 + exact-Q artifacts (https://github.com/lluiseriksson/mms-allocations-certificates, v1.0.0).
